8ddf3717ac: From Brazil, blending samba and jazz, with the bass on beats one and three and the chords played lightly in a syncopated rhythm. Today we just get to know its sound; playing it is outside this course.

Scales lay the groundwork, chords hold up the song,
accompaniment patterns bring the groove,
and twelve lessons of pop piano lead back to singing at the piano.
945eb5cccf: Start with pop songs you love: sing and play from a chord chart, then vary the accompaniment patterns freely. You can also pair this with Songwriting Lab to write piano accompaniment for your own songs.
